nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives POST from Bubble with author payload. Protected by x-api-key header auth.

nodes.name: Validate & Extract Input
nodes.notes: Validates payload, builds deduplication key (author + date). Throws on missing author_id.

nodes.name: Fetch Author Data from Bubble
nodes.notes: Pulls Author record from Bubble Data API. Alternatively full payload can be sent in webhook (both patterns are supported — see documentation).

nodes.name: Fetch Author's Books from Bubble
nodes.notes: Fetches all books belonging to this author from Bubble using constraint filtering.

nodes.name: Check Fetch Success
nodes.notes: Branches on whether Bubble Data API returned successfully. On failure, triggers error handler.

nodes.name: Aggregate Author & Book Data
nodes.notes: Computes consolidated royalty totals, classifies books as published vs in-production, determines payout status and next expected quarter.

nodes.name: Build AI Prompt
nodes.notes: Constructs the system and user prompts for the AI. Injects BookLeaf tone guidelines, payout policy, and all author-specific data. Handles all edge cases (no payout, overdue, in-production books).

nodes.name: Call OpenAI API
nodes.notes: Sends the crafted prompt to gpt-4o-mini. Replace API key with n8n credential. Temperature 0.7 for warm, natural tone.

nodes.name: Check AI Response
nodes.notes: Validates AI returned a valid response. Routes to error handler if AI call failed.

nodes.name: Extract AI Email Content
nodes.notes: Parses the raw AI output to extract Subject and Body separately. Preserves all upstream context for the callback.

nodes.name: Update Notification Log (Success)
nodes.notes: PATCHes the Bubble NotificationLog record with Success status, email content, timestamp, and token usage.

nodes.name: Respond 200 OK
nodes.notes: Returns success response to Bubble. Bubble uses this to confirm the workflow completed.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches errors from any node via error output connections. Formats structured error payload for logging.

nodes.name: Update Notification Log (Failed)
nodes.notes: PATCHes the Bubble NotificationLog with Failed status so the admin can see what went wrong.

nodes.name: Respond 500 Error
nodes.notes: Returns 500 to Bubble with error details. Bubble UI displays this to admin instead of an infinite spinner.
